svg.aria-label: Mockup on a screenshot of Kinboard's Home: the sleigh flies over the widgets, snow on the cards, the creatures in Santa hats, presents and stars from a tap, and a red and green colour wash
svg.title: Mockup on a screenshot of Kinboard's Home: the sleigh flies over the widgets, snow on the cards, the creatures in Santa hats, presents and stars from a tap, and a red and green colour wash

text.tspan: · the sleigh flies over the widgets, ~10 s, every 2 min
· snow on each card's top edge, lights on one, above the title row
· a Santa hat in the creatures' head slot (RFC-017's shop slots)
· tapping the sleigh drops presents and stars; the creatures cheer
· Christmas red from the top, pine green from the bottom
